title: nf-core/rnastructurome pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

condition.description: Sample condition for rf-norm grouping (treated / untreated / denatured). Samples sharing the same 'group' value with different conditions are normalised together by rf-norm.
condition.help_text: TODO (rnacentral-probing-metadata-main): merge_metadata.py must be updated to populate this column from the YAML 'conditions' field. Until then, samples without a condition are treated as 'treated'.

group.description: Group key linking treated / untreated / denatured samples for rf-norm (e.g. cell-line name). All samples with the same group value are normalised together.
group.help_text: TODO (rnacentral-probing-metadata-main): merge_metadata.py must be updated to populate this column (e.g. derived from sample_name by stripping the condition suffix). Defaults to sample_id at runtime if absent.
